_comment: Room 5 as the player's home (BACKLOG.md, plans/room5-home.md). npcgen builds Willem's sale of Caralion's old room and the spouse's 'Let's live at the Guild Hall.' from this file. The texts are drafts until 'approved' is true; Willem's lines must also be recorded. Until both, the builder holds them out of the plugin (AG_TALK_BUILD=1 builds them regardless). The spouse answers in vanilla's own recorded move lines, so 'home' has no spoken text of its own.

offer.text: He won't be needing it, and the hall can't carry an empty best room. A thousand gold and it's yours, fireplace and all.

take.text: Good. The room's yours, and everything in it. Treat it better than he did.

nofee.text: A thousand, I said. Come back when you have it.

later.text: Think on it. Empty rooms don't pay for this place's upkeep.

home.prompt: Let's live at the Guild Hall.
